_comment: Reviewed, nonclinical prompt catalog for PUBLIC marketing/educational media only.
Every entry must be human-reviewed before use and must contain the safety phrases
'no text' and 'no patient identifiers' (enforced by higgsfield/guard.py).
These prompts describe SYNTHETIC, illustrative visualizations. Generated media is
never derived from a real study, never medical evidence, and is never shown inside
Free-form prompts are refused at runtime - only ids listed here may be generated.

prompts.prompt: High-end scientific visualization of human lungs reconstructed from volumetric medical imaging, anatomically plausible proportions, detailed pulmonary surface and subtle internal bronchial structure, restrained partial translucency, controlled slow camera rotation, deep graphite background, sophisticated medical visualization lighting, premium medical technology presentation, no holograms, no glowing effects, no text, no labels, no patient identifiers, no logos, no diagnostic information.
